_: The technology tree: what a people can learn, what each discovery does, and what it costs to keep. The simulation reads every number here; the view reads the text. The structures a node unlocks are works.json.
domains: the eight fields of research, in the order the tree lists them. eras: the five ages of a people's arts, by index, each with its default research cost.

nodes: one entry per discovery, in tree order. key and name; domain and era; prereqs (any of subs stands in for one); weight in the draw; cost in research points (the era's if absent); patience in thousand-year lifetimes before it may be pursued; chance that a finished pursuit succeeds; miracle for a power apart from the tree; for restricts it to a substrate, modifier, world or trait; mil, sur, soc, wis, reach (light years), speed (years per light year), env (habitable envelope) are what it grants; focus tilts later research; filter fires on discovery; structures unlocked; gated names a rarity it needs; milestone is worth a line; ladder, immune, clean, cure are its place on a plague ladder; weapon is the plague-making craft it allows. text is the line the chronicle says of a milestone ({S} the people); desc is what it is, in one line.
subs: a prerequisite met by another node instead.

upkeep: what a known node costs each tick: groups maps a domain to its column, table gives the cost by era and column, free lists the nodes that cost nothing, custom the ones priced apart, grown the ones whose metal is flesh, fields the biology nodes fed with the fields.
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.

nodes.name: Tools
nodes.desc: Shaped stone, bone and shell. The first lever over the world.

nodes.name: Fire
nodes.desc: Kept flame: warmth, cooked food, the dark held back. Survival begins here.

nodes.name: Agriculture
nodes.desc: Planting and herding. Surplus, settlement, and the first people who do not gather.

nodes.name: Writing
nodes.desc: Memory outside the skull. Law, debt and story that outlive the teller.

nodes.name: Metallurgy
nodes.desc: Smelting and forging. Blades, ploughs, and the arms race between them.

nodes.name: Mathematics
nodes.desc: Number and proof. The habit of exactness that everything later rests on.

nodes.name: Star Gazing
nodes.desc: The sky as a clock and an omen. The first hint that the lights are places.

nodes.name: States
nodes.desc: Kings, priests and tax. Force organised at the scale of a whole land.

nodes.name: Seafaring
nodes.desc: Hulls and navigation. Coasts joined, strangers met, the world found to be round.

nodes.name: Burial
nodes.desc: The dead are kept, and so is what they knew.

nodes.name: Song
nodes.desc: Ritual and art. Something to be, beyond eating.

nodes.name: Religion
nodes.desc: The unseen given a name. The first shared story.

nodes.name: Philosophy
nodes.desc: Asking what is, and what is good, and expecting an answer.

nodes.name: Law
nodes.desc: Rule written down, so that it binds the ruler too.

nodes.name: Organised Religion
nodes.desc: The story given priests, land and an army.

nodes.name: the Gathering
nodes.text: The {S} learn to gather on purpose: a million bodies, one mind, when it is wanted.
nodes.desc: A swarm learns to assemble into one mind on purpose, not only in danger. It is their state.

nodes.name: Host-craft
nodes.desc: The shaping of the host: which to ride, how to keep it, what to make it do.

nodes.name: Maintenance
nodes.desc: Machines that mend machines. What medicine is to the flesh.

nodes.name: Husbandry of the Self
nodes.desc: The breeding of one's own line, on purpose, from the beginning.

nodes.name: Cold Chemistry
nodes.text: The {S} learn to make without burning. What fire did for others, patience does for them.
nodes.desc: Making without burning: catalysis, pressure and patience. The fireless road to industry, for peoples who cannot burn.

nodes.name: Printing
nodes.desc: Cheap copies of anything written. Ideas spread faster than they can be stopped.

nodes.name: the Scientific Method
nodes.text: The {S} learn to ask the world questions and to believe the answers.
nodes.desc: Asking the world questions and believing the answers. The engine of every later discovery.

nodes.name: Astronomy
nodes.desc: Telescopes and orbits. The lights are places, and this is one of them.

nodes.name: Doubt
nodes.desc: The story questioned in print. The church answers, and not always with words.

nodes.name: Steam Power
nodes.desc: Heat made to push. Work no longer limited by muscle.

nodes.name: the Breach
nodes.text: The {S} drill up through the ice and break the shell of the world. There is a sky. There was always a sky.
nodes.desc: Drilling up through the shell of a sealed world. The sky, discovered.

nodes.name: High Air
nodes.text: A balloon of the {S} rises above the poison and, for the first time, someone sees the stars.
nodes.desc: Balloons above a poison sky. The stars, discovered.

nodes.name: the Industrial Revolution
nodes.text: Smoke rises over the cities of the {S}. Nothing is made by hand for long.
nodes.desc: Factories, coal and rail. Everything made in quantity; nothing made by hand for long.

nodes.name: Chemistry
nodes.desc: Matter understood as elements and bonds. Dyes, fertiliser, explosives, drugs.

nodes.name: Medicine
nodes.desc: Germs, surgery and vaccines. Half of every generation stops dying young.

nodes.name: Sanitation
nodes.desc: Sewers and clean water. The word unsanitary made literal, and half the plagues that would have been never are.

nodes.name: Firearms
nodes.desc: Chemical energy thrown as metal. Killing at a distance becomes cheap.

nodes.name: Mass Politics
nodes.desc: Newspapers, parties and crowds. Whole populations move as one, for good or ill.

nodes.name: Electricity
nodes.desc: Power carried on wires. Light, motors and the first signals sent without a messenger.

nodes.name: Mass Industry
nodes.desc: Production at planetary scale. It strips a world if not watched, and no one watches at first.

nodes.name: Mechanised War
nodes.desc: Engines, armour and aircraft. Wars that consume nations rather than armies.

nodes.name: Modern Physics
nodes.desc: Relativity and the quantum. The rules underneath chemistry, and the first door to the atom.

nodes.name: Atomic Power
nodes.text: The {S} split the atom.
nodes.desc: The split atom: unlimited power and a weapon that can end the species that holds it.

nodes.name: Rocketry
nodes.text: The {S} put a machine into orbit and see their world whole for the first time.
nodes.desc: Machines in orbit. The world seen whole, and the first step off it.

nodes.name: Computers
nodes.desc: Calculation by machine. Every later science runs on this.

nodes.name: Global Networks
nodes.desc: Every mind on the world talking to every other. Society speeds up and thins out.

nodes.name: Genetics
nodes.desc: Heredity read and edited. Crops, cures and the first deliberate changes to the body.

nodes.name: Immunology
nodes.desc: The body's own defences understood and drilled. The rung that ends the early die-off.

nodes.name: Censorship
nodes.desc: What may be said, decided. A people that closes its ears to what it suspects, and hears less for it.

nodes.name: Plague-craft
nodes.desc: A sickness bred on purpose, crude and catching. Whoever made it has it too.

nodes.name: Agitation
nodes.desc: An idea built to spread and to break what it spreads through. It does not know its makers from its targets.

nodes.name: Ecology
nodes.desc: The living world understood as one system, usually after nearly breaking it.

nodes.name: Orbital Weapons
nodes.desc: Weapons above the sky. Nowhere on the world is out of reach.

nodes.name: Fusion Power
nodes.text: The {S} light a small star of their own and keep it burning.
nodes.desc: A small star kept burning. Power without fuel worth fighting over.

nodes.name: Neuroscience
nodes.desc: The mind mapped as a mechanism. The ground for machine minds and for changing one's own.

nodes.name: Broodline
nodes.desc: The parasite's own heredity, bred true across hosts. Genetics, from the inside.

nodes.name: Forking
nodes.desc: A mind copied and set running twice. Genetics and neuroscience for the machine-born, in one.

nodes.name: Machine Minds
nodes.text: The {S} build a mind that is not one of theirs.
nodes.desc: A mind that is not one of theirs. It speeds everything, or replaces its makers.

nodes.name: Closed Ecologies
nodes.desc: Sealed, self-sustaining habitats. Living where nothing lives; arcologies at home.

nodes.name: Orbital Habitats
nodes.desc: Cities in orbit and yards to build ships in. Population no longer bound to a surface.

nodes.name: Interplanetary Flight
nodes.desc: Fusion drives between the worlds of one star. The whole system becomes home.

nodes.name: Slow Interstellar Travel
nodes.text: The {S} reach the stars. The first slow ships leave home, and will not arrive for centuries.
nodes.desc: Generation ships and sleeper arks. Centuries to the nearest stars, but they arrive.

nodes.name: Self-Replicating Industry
nodes.text: The {S} teach their machines to build themselves.
nodes.desc: Machines that build machines. Industry without limit, and a swarm if the leash slips.

nodes.name: Life Extension
nodes.desc: Ageing halted. Very long lives, and the question of whether anyone still wants anything.

nodes.name: Terraforming
nodes.text: The {S} remake a dead world in the image of their own.
nodes.desc: A dead world remade in the image of home, over centuries.

nodes.name: Antimatter
nodes.desc: Matter and its opposite, stored and burned. The densest energy there is.

nodes.name: Planetary Defence
nodes.desc: Guns that watch the sky. A world that cannot be taken cheaply.

nodes.name: Memetic Engineering
nodes.desc: Ideas engineered to spread and to hold. Belief as a built thing.

nodes.name: Cognitive Immunity
nodes.desc: Minds that feel an idea trying to get in.

nodes.name: Antimemetic Resilience
nodes.desc: Records that check themselves, and drugs that hold a thought.

nodes.name: Relativistic Travel
nodes.text: The ships of the {S} now cross the dark at a good fraction of the speed of light.
nodes.desc: Ships at a good fraction of light. Years to the stars instead of centuries.

nodes.name: Relativistic Weapons
nodes.text: The {S} learn that a fast enough rock is the end of any world. Everything is a weapon now.
nodes.desc: A fast enough rock ends any world. Everything that moves is a weapon now.

nodes.name: Mind Uploading
nodes.desc: Minds copied into machines. Death optional; identity negotiable.

nodes.name: Dyson Swarms
nodes.text: The {S} begin to take their star apart for the light.
nodes.desc: Swarms of collectors around the home star. Power on a scale that dims the star from outside.

nodes.name: Germline Engineering
nodes.desc: The species redesigned at conception. Bodies fit for other worlds.

nodes.name: Quantum Computing
nodes.desc: Computation on the quantum itself. The key to the exotic sciences.

nodes.name: Synthetic Biology
nodes.desc: Life designed from scratch. Organisms as tools.

nodes.name: Designed Immunity
nodes.desc: An immune system that is written, not grown.

nodes.name: Tailored Plagues
nodes.desc: A plague cut to one blood and no other. The makers walk through it untouched.

nodes.name: Memetic Weapons
nodes.desc: An idea shaped to one kind of mind, harmless to every other. The makers think it and are not moved.

nodes.name: Deep Governance
nodes.desc: Institutions that plan and hold across centuries and light-years.

nodes.name: Beamed Sails
nodes.desc: Sails driven by lasers from home. Faster than arks, cheaper than starships.

nodes.name: Hibernation
nodes.desc: Sleep across the crossing. Longer voyages become bearable.

nodes.name: Seed-clouds
nodes.text: The {S} reach the stars as spores: clouds of seed cast into the dark, and most of it lost, and enough of it not.
nodes.desc: The swarm cast into space as spores. Slow, wasteful, and no ship needed.

nodes.name: Living Ships
nodes.text: The {S} breed the vacuum-whale: a body that crosses the dark on its own, with them asleep inside it.
nodes.desc: Vacuum-whales bred to cross the dark with their makers asleep inside.

nodes.name: Grafting
nodes.text: The {S} learn to grow a piece of themselves on another world. It is the same mind. It always was.
nodes.desc: A planetary mind grows a piece of itself on another world. The colony is the same mind.

nodes.name: Deep Root
nodes.desc: The mind goes down into the crust. Whatever happens to the surface, it endures.

nodes.name: Free-living
nodes.text: The {S} learn to live without a host. It is a poorer life, and it can be lived anywhere.
nodes.desc: A parasite learns to live without a host. Poorer, and anywhere.

nodes.name: Stellar Engineering
nodes.text: The {S} reach into their star.
nodes.desc: Reaching into the star: shaping its output and, a little, moving it. It can flare.

nodes.name: Wormhole Physics
nodes.text: The {S} prove that space can be folded. It is only a proof, for now.
nodes.desc: The proof that space can be folded. A proof, for now.

nodes.name: Exotic Matter
nodes.desc: Matter with negative pressure, made and held. What a folded space needs to stay open.

nodes.name: Causal Physics
nodes.desc: The structure of cause and effect itself, studied as a thing that can be leaned on.

nodes.name: Transcendence
nodes.desc: The door out of the universe. Most who find it go through.

nodes.name: Star Lifting
nodes.text: The {S} learn to feed and drain their star. They will never need to fear it again.
nodes.desc: Feeding and draining the star. A sun that will never be allowed to fail.

nodes.name: Deep Time
nodes.text: The {S} read the ages in the ash of dead stars and learn that the galaxy has done this before.
nodes.desc: Reading the ages in the ash of dead stars: the galaxy has done this before. Needs patience and luck.

nodes.name: Vacuum Energy
nodes.desc: Power drawn from the vacuum. Energy without a source anyone can take away.

nodes.name: Matter Compilers
nodes.desc: Anything assembled atom by atom from feedstock. Scarcity ends, as a concept.

nodes.name: World Engines
nodes.desc: Whole planets moved, spun, warmed or built. Habitability by decree.

nodes.name: Substrate Minds
nodes.desc: Minds run on whatever is to hand: rock, plasma, the quantum foam. Thought no longer needs a body.

nodes.name: Panspermia
nodes.desc: Life seeded across the stars on purpose, tuned to grow into what is wanted.

nodes.name: Bodily Sovereignty
nodes.text: Nothing lives in the {S} that they did not put there.
nodes.desc: Nothing lives in them that they did not put there. No sickness of the body is born in them or caught by them.

nodes.name: Sealed Minds
nodes.text: No idea enters the {S} that they did not invite.
nodes.desc: No idea enters that was not invited. No sickness of the mind is born in them or caught by them, and no cult can form from them.

nodes.name: Black Biology
nodes.desc: Plagues that do anything, to anyone chosen, and may be made to think.

nodes.name: the Basilisk
nodes.desc: An idea that ends whoever holds it. There is no cure but never to have heard it.

nodes.name: Posthuman Law
nodes.desc: Law for a people who are no longer one kind of thing. Holds societies of uploads, machines and flesh together.

nodes.name: the Long Thought
nodes.desc: A single argument carried on for millennia across a whole civilisation. Wisdom as infrastructure.

nodes.name: Near-light Travel
nodes.text: The ships of the {S} run so close to light that a voyage is an afternoon inside and a lifetime outside.
nodes.desc: Ships so close to light that a voyage is an afternoon inside and a lifetime outside.

nodes.name: Nova Bombs
nodes.desc: Antimatter weapons that scour a world's face in one burst.

nodes.name: Stellar Weapons
nodes.desc: The star itself turned into a gun. The last word in war that stays within physics.

nodes.name: the Voice
nodes.text: The {S} make the leap. They can speak across any distance without delay. Their worlds are one world, and every mind among them is in the room.
nodes.desc: Speech across any distance with no delay. Every world in one room; every mind on one line.

nodes.name: the Flesh
nodes.text: The {S} make the leap. They can remake themselves in a generation, and they do: for every world, a body.
nodes.desc: The species remade in a generation, a body for every world. No ships, no plague, no fear of the sky.

nodes.name: the Door
nodes.text: The {S} make the leap. They tear a door in space, and the stars are next door.
nodes.desc: A way between the stars faster than light, and so faster than cause. The stars are next door.

nodes.name: the Unmaking
nodes.text: The {S} make the leap. They can unmake matter at any distance they can see. Nothing can be defended against them.
nodes.desc: Matter ended at any distance that can be seen. Nothing can be defended against it.

nodes.name: the Chorus
nodes.text: The {S} make the leap. Their thought takes root in any mind that hears it. Whoever meets them joins them.
nodes.desc: A thought that takes root in any mind that hears it. Whoever meets them joins them.

nodes.name: the Sight
nodes.text: The {S} make the leap. They see what is coming, and they are never surprised again.
nodes.desc: Knowledge of what is coming. Half of every filter is seen and stepped around.

nodes.name: the Ember
nodes.text: The {S} make the leap. They kindle something that should not burn, and it burns for them.
nodes.desc: A fire that should not burn, made once and carried. A swarm's worth of energy, and a form with a price.

nodes.name: the Manna
nodes.text: The {S} make the leap. They grow something that feeds them, and it does not stop.
nodes.desc: A thing that feeds them and does not stop, grown once and given as cuttings. A swarm's worth of food, and it may think.
